systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Subcritical Water Dynamic Micro-Tubular Extraction & Fractionation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Ultra-High-Pressure Sanitary Hydrothermal Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 170.36 GRAS / FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / ASME BPVC Section VIII Div 1 & 2 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 60-01 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous High-Shear Micro-Tubular Helical Reactor with Dean Secondary Vortex Mixing (De > 450, Pe > 10,000), Multi-Zone High-Pressure Induction Heating (160–240°C, 150–250 bar), High-Pressure Ceramic Piston Feed Pump, Microsecond Cold-Water Quench Heat Exchanger (<1.5s thermal termination), and Automated Ceramic Orifice Back-Pressure Regulator (BPR)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Vacuum-Melted Inconel 625 Micro-Tubular Reactor Core (Ra ≤ 0.28 µm electropolished), Hastelloy C-276 High-Pressure Manifolds, Zirconia Toughened Alumina (ZTA) BPR Orifice, and FFKM Kalrez Sanitary Gaskets
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Hydraulic Rupture Burst Discs (300 bar Burst Rating at 250°C), Automated Emergency Over-Temperature Steam Quench Valve, In-Line Optical Pressure Transmitter Grid, and ASME Relief Quench Containment Tank
systemArchitectures.description: Flagship industrial continuous subcritical water micro-tubular hydrothermal fractionation skid. Operates across 150–250 bar and 160–240°C with Dean vortex plug-flow kinetics, selectively hydrolyzing agro-industrial hemicellulose matrices into high-value prebiotic xylooligosaccharides (XOS DP 2–6) without mineral acid catalysts or hazardous chemical solvent residues.

systemArchitectures.name: Aseptic Cleanroom Pharmaceutical Glycan & Polysaccharide Fractionation Unit
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pharmaceutical Glycan Extraction Skid (ISO 14644-1 Class 5 / EU GMP Annex 1 / USP <467> / USP <2021> / FDA 21 CFR § 211)
systemArchitectures.technology: Sanitary Twin-Coil Micro-Tubular Hydrothermal Reactor with Ultra-Fast Microwave-Assisted Induction Preheating and Integrated In-Line Tangential Ultrafiltration (1 kDa - 10 kDa cut-off)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Monolithic Solid Hastelloy C-22 Micro-Tubing (Ra ≤ 0.15 µm mirror electropolished), Diamond-Coated Regulating Needle Valve, and USP Class VI Platinum-Cured Perfluoroelastomer Sealing
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Triple-Redundant Ceramic Diaphragm Pressure Sensors, Automated High-Speed Cryogenic Water Quench Injection (<0.5s), and ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 2 Overpressure Rupture Bypass
systemArchitectures.description: Engineered for high-potency prebiotic glycomics, injectable immuno-modulatory polysaccharides, and pharmaceutical excipients. Delivers ultra-pure xylooligosaccharides with monodisperse DP distributions, zero heavy metal leaching, zero detectable furfural, and complete absence of residual mineral acids.

systemArchitectures.name: Industrial High-Throughput Agro-Industrial Biorefinery Integrated SCW-DME & HTC System
systemArchitectures.classification: Commercial High-Throughput Biorefinery Skid (FSSC 22000 / USDA Certified Biobased / ASME B31.3 / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Multi-Stage Continuous Annular Co-Axial Hydrothermal Reactor with Integrated Counter-Current Heat Exchanger Recuperation and High-Pressure Continuous Hydrochar Hydrocyclone Dewatering
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: ASME SA-182 F316L / 2205 Duplex Stainless Steel Cladding, Tungsten Carbide High-Pressure Slurry Check Valves, and Viton Extreme ETP Gaskets
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Continuous Slurry Viscosity Monitoring, Automated Line Flusher Purge System, Double Block and Bleed Isolation Manifold, and High-Temperature Burst Relief Line
systemArchitectures.description: Designed for multi-ton agro-industrial processing facilities handling sugarcane bagasse, corn stover, and brewer's spent grains. Sequentially extracts prebiotic oligosaccharides at 170–190°C followed by high-temperature hydrothermal carbonization (HTC at 220–240°C) to convert recalcitrant lignocellulosic residues into high-energy hydrochar pellets.

systemArchitectures.name: Modular Analytical R&D High-Pressure Subcritical Flow Viewcell Reactor
systemArchitectures.classification: Benchtop & Pilot Engineering Rig (ASME BPVC VIII / CE / UL 508A / GLP Laboratory Compliant)
systemArchitectures.technology: High-Pressure Optical Sapphire Window Viewcell Reactor (up to 300 bar at 280°C) with Micro-Thermocouple Array and Automated Multi-Fraction Fraction Collector
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Precision Micro-Bore Hastelloy C-276 with Grade 9 Synthetic Sapphire Viewing Ports and Kalrez 6375 O-Rings
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Microsecond Electronic Emergency Quench, High-Temperature Thermal Cutoff, and Mechanical Rupture Disc (320 bar rating)
systemArchitectures.description: Utilized by food science universities and biotechnology formulators to optimize hydrothermal hydrolysis reaction kinetics, water auto-ionization constants, and activation energy profiles across diverse lignocellulosic biomass streams.

feedstocks.name: Sugarcane Bagasse Agro-Industrial Fiber (Flagship Prebiotic)
feedstocks.description: Abundant agro-industrial milling byproduct characterized by high beta-(1,4)-xylan polymer fractions. Subcritical water dynamically cleaves xylan chains into prebiotic xylobiose (X2), xylotriose (X3), and xylotetraose (X4) with minimal monomeric xylose loss.

feedstocks.name: Brewer's Spent Grain (BSG) High-Protein Arabinoxylan Residue
feedstocks.description: Brewery coproduct rich in arabinoxylans and ester-linked ferulic acid. Subcritical water hydrolysis preserves feruloylated oligosaccharides (FA-AXOS), which deliver potent combined gut antioxidant and bifidogenic prebiotic properties.

feedstocks.name: Citrus Peel & Apple Pomace Pectin Arabinogalactan Residue
feedstocks.description: Fruit juice pressing residue dominated by pectic polysaccharides and soluble arabinogalactans. Hydrothermal treatment at 165°C extracts low-molecular-weight pectin oligosaccharides (POS) that stimulate beneficial gut Bacteroidetes.

feedstocks.name: Conventional Sulfuric Acid High-Temperature Cooking (CRITICAL HAZARD)
feedstocks.description: Toxic benchmark: conventional batch 1.5% H2SO4 acid cooking. Causes severe over-hydrolysis of oligosaccharides into monomeric xylose and dehydrates pentoses into toxic furfural (>4.5%) and 5-HMF (>2.2%), generating hazardous acid salt effluent and severe equipment stress.

reactorCoilDesigns.name: High-Shear Micro-Tubular Helical Coil (Inconel 625)
reactorCoilDesigns.description: Helical coil geometry creates secondary Dean vortices circulating perpendicularly to the primary flow axis. This secondary flow enhances radial heat transfer, eliminates tube center cold spots, narrows residence time distribution (RTD), and prevents char accumulation on inner tube walls.

reactorCoilDesigns.name: Annular Static-Mixer Counter-Current Reactor Tube (Duplex 2205)
reactorCoilDesigns.description: Designed for higher volumetric throughputs and coarse particulate slurries. Employs stationary internal baffle elements to split and recombine the hydrothermal slurry, maintaining acceptable temperature uniformity.

reactorCoilDesigns.name: Conventional Jacketed Batch Autoclave Pipe (Legacy Benchmark)
reactorCoilDesigns.description: Legacy straight pipe design exhibiting parabolic laminar flow profiles and severe radial thermal stratification (cold center, superheated perimeter). Causes simultaneous unhydrolyzed core material and scorched, degraded furfural near the heated wall.

engineeringFormulas.name: Subcritical Water Auto-Ionization Product (Marshall-Franck)
engineeringFormulas.description: Models the 1,000-fold increase in water ion product from 10^-14 at 25°C to >10^-11.2 at 200°C. Elevated hydronium ion concentration [H3O+] enables fast auto-catalytic cleavage of glycosidic bonds without added mineral acids.

engineeringFormulas.name: Subcritical Water Relative Permittivity (Dielectric Constant)
engineeringFormulas.description: Tracks the collapse of water's dielectric permittivity from ~80 at ambient to ~35 at 200°C (becoming non-polar like ambient ethanol), selectively solubilizing lignin oligomers and hydrophobic polyphenols.

engineeringFormulas.name: Overend-Chornet Hydrothermal Severity Factor (P-Factor)
engineeringFormulas.description: Quantifies the combined thermal and kinetic severity of hydrothermal processing. Optimal xylooligosaccharide extraction occurs precisely within log R0 = 3.6 to 4.2; values above 4.5 cause severe furfural degradation.

engineeringFormulas.name: Dean Number in Helical Micro-Tubular Flow
engineeringFormulas.description: Calculates the magnitude of secondary centripetal vortex recirculation in helical coils. For De > 400, intense Dean vortex pairs suppress laminar boundary layer buildup and eliminate hot-wall fouling.

engineeringFormulas.name: ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 1 Pressure Vessel Safety Factor
engineeringFormulas.description: Validates that high-strength solid Inconel 625 / Hastelloy micro-tubes maintain structural mechanical integrity with safety factor SF >= 4.0 under operating pressures up to 250 bar at 250°C.

regulatoryStandards.title: Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) Affirmation for Prebiotic Dietary Fibers
regulatoryStandards.scope: Affirms clean-water extracted xylooligosaccharides (XOS DP 2–6) as GRAS dietary fiber ingredients with no residual mineral acid or solvent limits.

regulatoryStandards.title: Residual Solvents in Dietary Supplements and Pharmaceutical Excipients
regulatoryStandards.scope: Mandates absence of toxic chemical extraction solvents (0.0 ppm for subcritical water process vs. strict ppm ceilings for petrochemical solvents).

regulatoryStandards.title: Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels (Divisions 1 & 2)
regulatoryStandards.scope: Hydrothermal reactor pressure rating up to 300 bar at 250°C, full radiographic weld inspection, and dual safety relief valves.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Vessels and Piping for Processing Liquid Food Products
regulatoryStandards.scope: Electropolished product-contact micro-tube bore (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm), sanitary Tri-Clamp fittings, and complete clean-in-place (CIP) drainability.

regulatoryStandards.title: Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) & Hazard Analysis (FSMA)
regulatoryStandards.scope: Sanitary validation of thermal hold times, monitoring furfural/HMF degradation byproducts, and microbiological safety assurance.

operationalModes.name: Selective Prebiotic XOS Extraction Mode (DP 2–6)
operationalModes.primaryBenefit: Maximizes bifidogenic prebiotic oligosaccharides without toxic furfural degradation or mineral acid waste.

operationalModes.name: Hydrothermal Carbonization (HTC) Hydrochar Mode
operationalModes.targetOutput: > 70% Solid Carbon Recovery | High Heating Value (HHV > 24 MJ/kg)
operationalModes.primaryBenefit: Converts spent lignocellulosic residues into clean, smokeless solid bio-coal pellets and activated carbon precursors.

operationalModes.name: Ferulic Acid & Polyphenol Subcritical Cleavage Mode
operationalModes.primaryBenefit: Leverages collapsed water dielectric permittivity to gently dissolve and liberate ester-linked natural antioxidants.
